appDownload.seoDesc: Download the official FK Gračanica Android app and follow the install guide.
appDownload.title: Android app
appDownload.subtitle: Download the APK and follow the steps. Enable unknown sources only if Android blocks the install.
appDownload.empty: There is no published app version right now.
appDownload.step1: Open this page in Chrome on your phone.
appDownload.step3: If Chrome warns that the file may be harmful, choose Download anyway.
appDownload.step4: Open the file from the notification or Downloads.
appDownload.step5: Only if Android blocks the install: Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps → Chrome (or Files) → allow for that app only.
appDownload.step6: Go back to the APK → Install → Open.
appDownload.playProtect: Google Play Protect may scan the app — allow the install.
appDownload.iosNote: On iPhone the native app is not on the App Store. Use this website.
appDownload.pwaNote: This is the full Android app, not a home-screen shortcut (PWA).
